decision_rule.ledger_score: sum of the three surface tests plus warm_wet_score; maximum is 5

primary_gt.interpretation: 5/5 ledger supports strong VV change with weak area-mean dNBR and warm-wet loading.

criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON fields with numeric values and the final classification string.
criteria.name: JSON schema
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for all numeric fields but missing the classification; 1 point for a parseable but incomplete JSON object.

criteria.description: Uses the package values for VV mean change, dNBR mean and max, three precipitation means, and mean daily maximum temperature.
criteria.name: Source metric extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for each correct extracted input value, up to 4 points.

criteria.description: Computes radar_margin_db = 1.89, dnbr_margin = 0.057, and dnbr_mean_to_max = 0.052 within tolerance.
criteria.name: Surface threshold calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.5 points for each correct surface value and 0.5 point for correct formulas.

criteria.description: Computes the three-source precipitation mean as 166.4 mm and assigns warm_wet_score = 2.
criteria.name: Warm-wet score
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for the precipitation mean only; 1 point for the temperature threshold only.

criteria.description: Combines the three surface passes and two warm-wet passes into ledger_score = 5 and the expected classification.
criteria.name: Ledger result
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for the correct ledger score without the exact classification; 1 point for the right pass count logic with an arithmetic error.

criteria.description: Gives a concise interpretation tied to the computed ledger without adding casualty, damage, or direct runout assertions.
criteria.name: Bounded interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for a concise interpretation with one uncomputed extra assertion.
